candidates.name: Armyansk-Dzhankoi Gas Pipeline

evidence.note: Linear part of the high-pressure trunk Armyansk-Dzhankoi finished, 72.5 km; Zangas-NGS general contractor for Ukrtransgaz; adds up to 4.5 bcm/y capacity to Crimea; commissioning planned end-2011.
Crimean GTS forks north near Krasnoperekopsk toward Dzhankoi-Feodosia-Kerch and toward Simferopol-Sevastopol.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row has an Armyansk or Dzhankoi endpoint; Crimea = Ukraine per naming conventions. Length 72.5 km (linear part). Commissioning date and current status not confirmed.

candidates.name: Dzhankoi-Feodosia-Kerch Gas Pipeline

evidence.note: Existing trunk Dzhankoi-Feodosia-Kerch built in 2000; Kerch Strait line to join it at its km 247, so at least 247 km long. A 268.33 km figure surfaced in search but its page could not be verified.
Crimean GTS branches toward Dzhankoi-Feodosia-Kerch in the east.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster match (no Crimea trunks listed). Length at least 247 km, probably about 268 km. Feeds the Kuban-Crimea tie-in.

candidates.name: Dzhankoi-Simferopol-Sevastopol Gas Pipeline

evidence.note: Crimean GTS forks near Krasnoperekopsk toward Simferopol with continuation to Sevastopol.
Item 141 (Glebovka-Simferopol-Sevastopol phase 3) is described as increasing transport in the Crimean GTS, implying the earlier phases/trunk exist.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row. Length unknown (Soviet-era trunk, several hundred km likely). Evidence is thin; possibly several segments (Armyansk-Dzhankoi-Simferopol, Simferopol-Sevastopol).

candidates.name: Glebovka-Simferopol-Sevastopol Gas Pipeline, phase 3

evidence.note: Annex 4 item 141: 102 km, 500 mm, 8.193 mcm/d, Bakhchisaray/Saki/Simferopol districts and Sevastopol.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not in roster; carried from Russia D6 run. Earlier phases 1-2 likely exist and are also absent.

candidates.name: Ochertay Bay-Glebovka UKPG Gas Pipeline (second string)

evidence.note: Annex 4 item 292: second string 43.65 km, 700 mm, 5.4 MPa, Chernomorsky district, gas to Glebovka UGS.

candidates.name: Odeske-Holytsynske Subsea Gas Pipeline
aka: Odesa field BK-1 to Holytsynske MSP-4
candidates.from: Odeske gas field platform BK-1 (Black Sea shelf)

evidence.note: 83 km underwater pipeline welded, linking BK-1 of Odeske and MSP-4 of Holytsynske; described as Ukraine's longest.
Odeske to be tied to developed Holitsynske by an almost 90 km pipeline.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster match. Offshore field line; GulfPub Golitsynskoe-Glebovskoe (107.8 km) is the onward line to shore. Include only if offshore field lines are in scope.

candidates.name: Holytsynske-Glebovka Gas Pipeline (field to onshore processing and storage)

evidence.note: Item 292 shows the Ochertay Bay-Glebovka trunk bringing Black Sea gas ashore to the Glebovka UGS; a first string exists.

candidates.why_maybe_new: GulfPub seeds 1597 (107.8 km) and 1599 Shtormove-Glebovskoe (115.9 km). No independent length source found; may be the same onshore trunk as Ochertay-Glebovka plus subsea legs. Length unknown beyond GulfPub.

candidates.name: Dzhankoi-Henichesk Gas Pipeline (Crimea to Kherson Oblast reverse flow)

evidence.note: Crimea-Henichesk pipeline planned in reverse mode versus old Kherson-Crimea flow.
Main gas pipeline from Crimea into Kherson Oblast completed; Henichesk supply raised.
Governor Saldo: reverse pipeline Crimea to southern Kherson Oblast built, 1.7 bn rubles.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Seed ru-d6:dzhankoi-genichesk. Length unknown (a search summary said about 105 km, unverified). Likely rebuild of the Soviet Kherson-Crimea line; no roster row. P5989/P7818 do not cover it.

candidates.name: Krasnodar Krai-Crimea Gas Pipeline (Kuban-Crimea)

evidence.note: Kuban-Crimea 395-400 km, 4 bcm/y, crosses Kerch Strait, commissioned end-2016.
About 400 km, 16 km underwater, DN700 main line with two DN500 branches.
Pipeline completed 2016; now feeds reverse flow to Kherson/Zaporizhzhia.
